summary: Installing an exact SDK into a multi-SDK root does not itself establish exact CLI selection under latestFeature policy. The maintained hosted workflow now preserves the image SDK tree by a guarded no-clobber same-filesystem sibling rename before the pinned setup action installs SDK10.0.401 into the unchanged /usr/share/dotnet root. Provider, real-directory/path, destination-absence and device checks precede rename; source absence and retained device/inode identity are read back before setup proceeds. Existing trusted-image/C-toolchain custody, exact SDK/path checks, normalization, native flags and job budgets remain. The pre-normalization probe requires successful exit plus exact10.0.401 and retains original stdout/stderr/exit in a fresh private directory, with a separate always-run diagnostic artifact route. Pure controls exercise preserved identity/content, refusal without clobber including a racing destination, exact setup ordering and wrong-version/failed-probe evidence before custody changes. This is source preparation with pure filesystem/shell validation only: no .NET/runtime execution, actual hosted CI success, published or installed adoption is established by this record. The original hosted refusal discarded its selected-version stdout, so that original version remains Unknown; later setup/image/source observations do not reconstruct it. Root owns exact final integration, required CI, final source/closure qualification and any applicable effects. No new SDK/image allowance, global policy change, reservation release, native activation or measured saving follows.
title: Exact hosted SDK setup requires isolation from preinstalled resolver candidates
